description: Show the current AWS identity (account, role ARN, user ID) plus SSO token status and time remaining. Use this first to verify auth before running other AWS operations. Returns a structured fix-it message if SSO is expired.

profile.description: AWS profile name. Defaults to $AWS_PROFILE or 'default'.

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to $AWS_REGION or us-east-1.

name: aws_whoami
